Know What the Examiner Wants

To score well in exams, it is essential to know what is being examined. An examiner will look for responses – Fluency and Coherence, Lexical Resource, Grammar and Accuracy and Pronunciation.

Practice Speaking English

We know that practice makes man perfect. You must listen and read English academic articles regularly. Speak with people around you in English so that you can improve your Vocabulary, Grammar and Speaking skills.

Find a Speaking Companion

It will be good if you find someone to practice English with you. Especially those people who can talk about something that you are interested in. This will help you in making your preparation much easier and will not get bored.

Attend Community Events

Community events are an excellent place to practice your speaking skills. With this you can improve your English-speaking skills. You can have fun and will get chance to talk to a variety of people in an interesting way.

Record Yourself

While practicing speaking topics, you must record your responses. Listen the recording, determine your mistakes, note them down and you can avoid these mistakes in the actual test.

Talk to a Mirror

Sit in front of the mirror, speak to yourself and you must learn to make eye contact. The thing is most of the examiners are influenced byaspirants who make eye contact and due to this reason, you can get a generous score.
